title: Cordova Museum

services.name: Permanent Exhibits
services.desc: Encompassing more than half of the museum’s public footprint, the permanent exhibits highlight and bring to life the region’s history with carefully curated displays. Mostly hand-crafted by talented staff and locals, the displays focus on preserved artifacts, vivid staging, and photograhic records. The limited descriptions allow visitors to find their own connections to Cordova’s history and hopefully inspire curiosity and a desire to learn more after their visit ends. Nature’s Wonders: Reflections on the region’s amazing landscape and living creatures.
